{
  "candidate_id": "candidate-3",
  "filepath": "index.js",
  "changed_line": 30,
  "statement": "forOwn(obj, copy, o);",
  "function_name": "deepMixin",
  "operation_type": "object_iteration",
  "source_summary": "The function deepMixin accepts an object 'o' and variable arguments. The 'obj' values come from the arguments passed to deepMixin after the first argument. These are user-provided objects that get mixed into the target object 'o'.",
  "sink_summary": "The copy function assigns values directly to the target object 'o' via 'this[key] = value' (line 23) when objects are not both plain objects. This property assignment can modify the prototype chain if keys include special properties like __proto__ or constructor.",
  "guard_summary": "The isObject check (is-plain-object) validates if values are plain objects before recursive deepMixin calls, but does not protect against prototype pollution. There are no explicit guards against malicious property names that could pollute the object prototype.",
  "risk_pattern": "Untrusted objects are iterated and their properties are copied to a target object without validation of property names, enabling prototype pollution if properties like __proto__ or constructor are present.",
  "used_variable_sources": ["args (from function arguments)", "obj (from args[i])", "o (target object from first argument)"],
  "called_function_context": ["forOwn (iterates over own properties of obj)", "isObject (checks if value is plain object)", "copy (handles property assignment)"],
  "enclosing_conditions": ["obj != null (line 29)", "len > 0 (implicit from loop)"],
  "context_summary": "The deepMixin function deeply merges objects by recursively copying properties. The candidate statement iterates over each property of source objects and copies them to the target object.",
  "unresolved_facts": ["Specific version behavior of for-own and is-plain-object dependencies", "Whether the module is used in contexts with attacker-controlled objects", "Presence of any upstream validation before deepMixin is called"]
